decisions.decision: Build T-468 end to end on a branch off main. 1) Simulator: add Metricool per-post analytics (reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, followers, tagged by format, pillar and profile), GA4 blog page reports, Wistia video stats (plays, play rate, watch-through), Tantra newsletter and WhatsApp campaign stats, and UTM registrations. 2) cloud/src/dashboard.ts collectDash: read each one with the attendee's stored keys, building on the T-265 Tantra and Metricool reads. If a read fails, show 'Not connected', never a planned count. Add a content panel beside the funnel that traces each post from reach to registrations to booked calls via utm_content. 3) Add the same view to the OS kit (kits/dashboard, shared with T-457) so it builds the same panel. 4) Write probe-t468.mjs to assert every metric renders from the simulator at 375, 768 and 1280, and run tsc. 5) Deploy the revops-centre Worker, push to main, then move the task to review.
